sources.fact: LBBD states outline planning permission was given on 11 June 2018 for an 850-home Gascoigne West redevelopment replacing 179 flats and creating an uplift of 671 homes.
17/00977/OUT granted an outline framework for up to 850 dwellings across seven development parcels.
19/01320/OUT varied the extant 17/00977/OUT permission for Phase 1 and retained reserved-matters requirements.
The Council describes the first-stage detailed design as more than 200 new homes; this is phase-specific and not the whole 850.
Gascoigne West Phase 2 sought 386 residential units with a residents hub and associated works.
The 386-home Phase 2 application affects heritage settings and is a distinct full application rather than a simple reserved-matters count to add blindly to every other phase number.
LBBD records a Gascoigne Estate West Phase 2 CPO and demolition programme supporting land assembly and delivery.
CPO/demolition powers concern specified land and do not substitute for exact current HMLR title/proprietor relations in the canonical parcel pipeline.
The outline scheme included target/affordable/shared-ownership housing components; tenure mix is planning evidence rather than legal title evidence.
19/01320/OUT was subject to a S106 Deed of Variation and conditions; committee resolution is preserved with those dependencies.
Demolition and estate-renewal information is concrete delivery context but does not establish that all 850 dwellings are completed or occupied.
Exact application and decision references remain required for each current phase status.

examples.result: 850 is the outline maximum; it is not treated as a completed-home count.
179 replaced homes and 671 uplift are retained as scheme arithmetic, not separate add-on capacity.
19/01320/OUT is a variation of the outline framework, not a new extra 850 homes.
Phase 1 more-than-200 and Phase 2 386 remain phase-specific.
CPO/demolition evidence supports land assembly but is not exact HMLR title evidence.
S106/conditions remain attached to planning scope.
Estate-renewal progress is not extrapolated to full 850-home completion.
Promotion remains zero until exact canonical parcel/title relation and executed statutory overlays are verified.
